discussion_comments.comment_body: Reproduced with the expanded regression: the previous helper appended a duplicate update table. Fixed in ff535dd8 using toml_edit DocumentMut and TableLike for the updater preference edit; this reuses the existing locked parser dependency with no new package versions. The config writer now evaluates fallible edits before writing. Coverage passes for commented and quoted headers, inline and dotted tables, preservation of explicit channel formatting and other settings, and malformed TOML/non-table update values leaving original bytes unchanged. Full local validation passes with only the previously documented EFS fixture exclusion.
Fixed. Letta settings are now parsed, validated, and persisted before the final versioned hook file is written. A malformed-settings regression test verifies no hook file is left behind.

Fixed in aff8c795. The trailing inline comment on the flow line is now captured with `yaml_inline_comment` and reattached to the regenerated block header, so `enabled: [example-plugin] # managed locally` becomes `enabled: # managed locally` followed by the list items. Added regression tests for both the `enabled` and top-level `plugins` flow forms.

Fixed in aff8c795. `yaml_flow_sequence_items` now preserves each item's raw scalar representation; only matching decodes via `yaml_scalar_value`. Rendering emits the original quoted token, so a value like `"other # plugin"` or `"null"` stays a quoted string. Added regression tests for YAML-significant characters through both install and uninstall.

Addressed in 3d4313d8. `normalize_utf8_bom` now strips only a leading BOM plus line-start BOMs that are displaced into an invalid document. When the document still parses, a line-start U+FEFF can only be string data inside a multiline value, so it is preserved. Added regression tests for both multiline basic and literal strings, plus the displaced-BOM recovery case.

Addressed in 3d4313d8. `normalize_utf8_bom` now strips only a leading BOM plus line-start BOMs that are displaced into an invalid document. When the document still parses, a line-start U+FEFF can only be string data inside a multiline value, so it is preserved. Added regression tests for both multiline basic and literal strings, plus the displaced-BOM recovery case.

Good catch. I changed the specific unknown-key banner to apply only when every diagnostic is an unknown-key warning. Mixed diagnostics now retain the existing generic `config.toml; herdr config check` banner, so an unknown key cannot shadow a failed section. Added a mixed invalid-section/unknown-key regression; focused summary and live-reload tests plus `just lint` pass. Fixed in 9f64f3e.
